title: Betrix
description:
Welcome to our Discord 

Betrix is ​​a unique block game that combines the block puzzle game and the music game, allowing you to play with the rhythm of music in the stack.INNOVATIVEBrand new game mechanics. There is no limit to the player's operation on the block. 
Players get points for placing blocks at the time position of a single note. Facing long notes, players can freely Stack blocks for high scores but also watch out for garbage block attacks.

DAZZLINGAmazing effects are designed to create a simple and gorgeous visual style.

CLASSIC Retain the classic gameplay such as 40 lines, limit 3 minutes, etc. leaderboard is provided, and players can challenge themselves to get higher scores.
OPENThe game has a level editor to unleash your creativity and share it with other players in the workshop.
